runs.text:
Follow these safety rules before using the machine:

- Lower the guard to the recommended distance from the workpiece before you turn on the blade.
- Check the tensioning wheel regularly during your shift, no matter how the guard is positioned. Tension can drift even if you haven't used the machine much.
- Check the lower blade guide for wear every time you change the blade. If you replace it with a blade of the same width and pitch, you only need to look it over quickly — but only after you've finished the tensioning steps described elsewhere in this manual.
- Don't wear loose clothing or jewelry near the machine, and tie back long hair.
- Wait until the blade has fully stopped before you leave the work area. The machine can stay hot for several minutes afterward, so be careful.
